paragraph: Granville’s composite registers a defensive 38/100, delivering an outright risk-off verdict as internal market plumbing deteriorates despite the absence of an active breadth divergence. Acute risk aversion dominates the underlying signals, highlighted by a -3.02% plunge in beta leadership (SPHB/SPLV), severe distribution in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY down -2.54%), and a pronounced +1.70% flight into defensive staples (XLP/XLY). This internal decay is unfolding beneath a deceptively calm headline surface, where the VIX prints at 15.21 in steep contango (running 7.7 out to 17.9) even as high-yield credit spreads widen to 3.15% and small-cap ratios languish at 0.3572. Although a back-loaded volatility skew of -7.5 points and falling 10-year real yields at 2.87% indicate macro desks are hedging down-funnel event risk rather than pressing an immediate panic button, the tape lacks genuine offensive sponsorship. Lean tactically bearish for the session, fading early index strength and favoring defensive positioning until semiconductor leadership and risk appetite stabilize.
